methodology.load: Existing evaluation clients continue sharing the same replicas; not isolated peak capacity.
methodology.scheduling: BF16 direct and NVFP4 direct tests overlap on independent hardware; BF16 public tests run afterward.
methodology.generation: Unique nonce before repeated context avoids complete-prompt prefix-cache hits; output capped/forced to 256 tokens with ignore_eos. Synthetic nonbenchmark requests.
methodology.ttft: Client POST start to first SSE delta with nonempty reasoning_content/content/tool_calls; includes queue, prefill and transport. Empty role chunks are excluded.
methodology.visible_answer: First visible answer is recorded separately; it can be absent in a thinking-only 256-token response.
methodology.decode_speed: (completion_tokens-1)/(last nonempty token-delta time-first nonempty token-delta time); token count is from server usage, not chunk count.
methodology.batch_throughput: Total probe completion tokens divided by batch wall time; excludes unrelated evaluation tokens.
methodology.limits: Three single-request repetitions per input case; one batch each at concurrency 4/8. No p95, long-context SLA, or maximum throughput claim.
